nodes.label: .`open creates a directory and a client with the key and waits for the phone step`()
.`open fails with TelegramUnavailable when TDLib never reaches the phone step`()
.`a phone step maps to its outcome`()
.`an unregistered number maps to PhoneUnregistered and closes the client`()
.`WaitRegistration after the code maps to PhoneUnregistered and closes the client`()
.`a code step maps to its outcome`()
.`a resend Telegram refuses for the phone maps to the phone step's outcome (AC-107)`()
.`a code check Telegram refuses for the phone maps to the phone step's outcome (AC-107)`()
.`a password step returns the hint, then authorizes with the phone reduced to code and last two digits`()
.`a step Telegram does not answer throws TelegramUnavailable`()
.`reopening two stored sessions makes both Ready with increasing sequences and asks the Owner for nothing`()
.`a reopen that races one finishing opens one client and keeps the first session (AC-111)`()
.`connection loss is Connecting and recovery is Ready, never Closed`()
.`Updating is connected and catching up, so it is Ready and never Connecting (AC-122)`()
.`a stored session Telegram ended while teleX was stopped is Closed on reopen`()
.`a session ended by Telegram while running is Closed once`()
.`closing a session ourselves is not a lost session`()
.`logOut is true when Telegram closes the session in time and false when it does not`()
.`a session is authorized once Ready is reached, also when the step that saw it timed out (AC-109, AC-04)`()
.`a client that fails to open leaves nothing behind and shutdown does not hang`()
.`destroy closes the client and deletes the directory`()
.`configured needs both the api id and the api hash`()
